item.title: Green Stocks Jan 1: Quite Start In New Year For Green Pack
item.description: As expected, there was nothing much of consequence for the green pack on the first day of trading in the new year. item.title: UP: NTPC Issues EPC Tender for 250 MW Solar Plus 50 MW/200 MWh BESS Project
item.description: NTPC Renewable Energy Limited (NTPC REL) has recently issued an EPC tender package to develop a 250 MW solar project with a 50 MW/200 MWh Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) at Sitapur in Uttar Pradesh (UP). It has sought bids until February 6, 2026. item.title: Premier Energies Secures Orders Worth ₹2,307.30 Crore in Q3 FY26
item.description: Indian solar module manufacturing firm Premier Energies Limited said it has secured new orders worth ₹2,307.30 crore during the third quarter of FY26, with execution scheduled across FY27 and FY28. The contracts were awarded by a mix of leading domestic independent power producers and other prominent customers in India, reflecting sustained demand for the company’s integrated solar manufacturing capabilities. item.title: UP’s Bundelkhand Now Flaunts 17,515 Acres of Land for Solar Projects
item.description: The Bundelkhand region of Uttar Pradesh is offering around 17,515 acres of land for hosting solar projects in the state. The state government has identified these land parcels as suitable for utility-scale, ground-mounted solar power projects. The Uttar Pradesh New and Renewable Energy Development Agency (UPNEDA) has issued a revised list of its land bank available for clean energy projects, primarily solar, in the region.
